items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Carol Tucker, David James, Ted Donnelly

ctx.x: And piano, we have Dan Michael, Raymond Tunia, Freddy Washington, Gene Rogers.

And then, the list in memorium here that we have talked about - cellus Green, James Morrison, Bill Johnson, Avery Parrish, Carol Tucker, David James, Ted Donnelly, Ace Harris, Captain Sims, Lee Stanfield, Bob Range, Joe Murphy, Jimmy Mitchelle, and Dud Bascomb.

Well, Carol Tucker was another girl vocalist. You know, she was a young girl I got out of Chicago. She came back-stage at the Regal Theatre. This, and then for me to hear her sing. And then, I decided to take her along. She was beautiful. I was going from Chicago to Detroit and she met me in Detroit
